## Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
raw_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                             "01_dat_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

sample_map_raw <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                                   "01_sample_map_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

clinical_raw <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                                 "01_clin_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)


```

## Clean data

```{r}
clean_df <- raw_df |>   
  drop_na(gene_name) |>   
  mutate(sample_id = basename(dirname(file))) |>   
  select(c("sample_id",             
           "gene_id",             
           "gene_name",             
           "gene_type",             
           "unstranded",
           "tpm_unstranded"))

sample_map_clean <- sample_map_raw |> 
  select(
    sample_id = id,
    submitter_id = cases.submitter_id,
    sample_type
  )

clinical_clean <- clinical_raw |> 
  select(submitter_id,
         vital_status,
         sex_at_birth,
         eln_risk_classification,
         primary_diagnosis)
```

## Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(clean_df,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"))

readr::write_tsv(clinical_clean,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_clin_clean.tsv.gz"))
readr::write_tsv(sample_map_clean,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_sample_map_clean.tsv.gz"))
```
